# Fixtures for `swf` (Shockwave Flash)

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for the fictitious Saltmere Harbour. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/longtail.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `harbour-clip.swf` | craft_longtail.py (SWF 19 tags; zlib and LZMA), ffmpeg 7.1 (SWF muxer) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-as2.swf` | craft_longtail.py (SWF 19 tags; zlib and LZMA), ffmpeg 7.1 (SWF muxer) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-as3.swf` | craft_longtail.py (SWF 19 tags; zlib and LZMA), ffmpeg 7.1 (SWF muxer) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-abc.swf` | craft_packages5e.py (FileAttributes and a DoABC2 tag with the `flash_abc` fixture's ABC) | CC0-1.0 |
